The workflows test above does exercise the interceptor via UndoLastTransitionButton.

rca of the issue: Previously: UndoLastTransitionButton.refresh() on every incident detail mount fired axios GET /api/workflows/{workflow}/{id}/last-transition without skipSessionStatus. For Safety-only viewers this 401'd; api.js interceptor lacked /api/workflows/* in namespaced-silent list so classifyApiError → publishSessionStatus → global session_expired overlay covered valid detail content. Fix applied and verified: (1) api.js lines 176-179 add isWorkflowsHelper/isNotificationsHelper/isOperationsHelper, line 211-215 absorbs them silently (no token wipe, no overlay publish); (2) UndoLastTransitionButton line 48-49 passes {skipSessionStatus:true} as defensive belt-and-braces; (3) ViewIncident line 263 emits safety-nav-back testid on /safety-portal/* pathname. All 7 acceptance flows now pass.
